messages:
Amelia Torres: hi all! i'm Amelia — just started today on product analytics. moved up from LA, fueled by cold brew and an alarming number of cats. quick q: are plants allowed at desks? also any recs for good lunch tacos near the office? :wave: :cat2:
Jordan Lee: welcome Amelia!! tacos: 'Taqueria Sol' two blocks down is 🔥. plants yes! just avoid the succulents that attract gnats (learned that the hard way). also coffee meetup at 10:30 by the big window? :coffee: 
Priya Singh: omg welcome!! i'll bring a tiny pothos clipping tomorrow if you want — low maintenance. also there's a slack channel #plants-and-pets for amp'd plant memes. :seedling: 
Sam Patel: welcome! cat fact: cats have fewer toes on their back paws — 4 vs 5 front. random but i thought you'd appreciate. :cat: 
Amelia Torres: love cat facts!! yes please @Priya that would be amazing. @Jordan 10:30 works, i'll bring pastries. also where do i grab my badge? i didn't see an email yet.
Rafael Gomez: badge pickup is at reception M-F 9-5, bring ID. if they give you a temporary QR, ping me and i'll add you to the office wifi. welcome aboard! :id: 
Nina Flores: @Amelia we have a sticker wall in the kitchen you can add to. also FYI free bagels on Thursdays. :bagel: 
onboarding-bot: onboarding checklist reminder: please complete HR forms, set up 2FA, and join #new-hires. Helpful links: https://redwood.example/onboard (posted by onboarding-bot)
Amelia Torres: amazing, thank you everyone! excited to be here :smile: see you all at 10:30
